attempts.summary: Joined node1, node2, and node3 into a single RabbitMQ 4.3.5 cluster (Erlang 27) on RHEL10, created the `payments` vhost with a durable quorum queue `payments.orders` (exchange `payments.events`, routing key `orders`) replicated across all 3 nodes, and an `app_user` account scoped to that vhost that can publish and consume. Verified messages published to the durable queue survive the loss of a node and remain consumable from the surviving nodes. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time OS reboot protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot identity and full cluster/data recovery after each.
